import sys

    from collections import defaultdict
    
    # Dictionary to store the frequency of each element in the sequence
    freq = defaultdict(int)
    
    # Calculate the total weight of all subsegments
    total_weight = 0
    
    # Iterate over each element in the sequence
    for i in range(n):
        # Update the frequency of the current element
        freq[a[i]] += 1
        
        # Calculate the contribution of the current element to the total weight
